subject: Optimize Toolkit: on-prem quant + cache pilot economics & ops
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@northstarlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Optimize Toolkit: on-prem quant + cache pilot economics & ops

Hi Emily —

Great to meet earlier this week. I wanted to follow up with a concise pilot proposal for an on-prem evaluation of our Optimize toolkit focused on batching, KV caching, and a hybrid quant strategy. High-level asks from your side were: predictable unit economics, minimal fidelity regression, and a safe rollback path.

What we recommend for the pilot (2-week live evaluation + perf window):
- Quant strategy: hybrid-quant profile (q8 -> q4 tiering). Keep the base model in q8 for generation, fall back to q4 for long-history recall paths. This reduces memory/GPU footprint while limiting visible hallucination risk for short contexts.
- Batching: continuous batching with a 25ms dispatch window and request priority lanes for low-latency routes. Typical throughput uplift 1.6–2.2x depending on request size distribution.
- KV cache: session-affinity prefix cache with 48-hour TTL for user sessions; expected token reduction for multi-turn flows of ~30–45%.
- Fallbacks & rollback: automatic model-variant fallback and per-route canaries; we can pin a model to q8-only for any route to revert immediately.

Pilot economics proposal (initial sketch):
- Pilot credits: 50,000 tokens covered by Redwood for the evaluation period.
- Technical support: 8 hours engineering onboarding + dedicated solutions contact.
- Optional: a one-time 20% discount on first 3 months of a Dedicated commit if you convert within 30 days of pilot close.

Attachments: pilot-econ-sheet.xlsx (cost model), runbook-onprem.pdf (ops runbook).

If this looks good I can loop in Solutions and Research to scope the canary plan and get a formal term sheet over. Would you prefer a quick 30-minute call tomorrow or should I send the draft offer now?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Solutions Sales
Redwood Inference

--

Aditya —

Thanks, this is exactly the level of detail I wanted. A few quick clarifying questions from my team:
1) Can you sketch expected latency change for short (<=64 tokens) vs longer (>=512 tokens) flows with the hybrid profile?
2) What fidelity testing do you run to ensure q4 fallback is not introducing semantic regressions for our invoices/retrieval prompts?
3) The 50k token credit — is that measured as input+output tokens, and will we see live token usage in the console? Procurement is also asking whether the discount is stackable with any marketplace credits.

We're keen but procurement needs the cost/savings delta and rollback language before we greenlight infra access. A quick call tomorrow at 11am PT works for me if you have Solutions on the line.

Best,
